bad_pr.title: Optimize partition w/ expensive predicate
bad_pr.body: Since calling the predicate might be expensive, call it ahead of the tee so it will not need to be evaluated separately in each branch of the tee, taking up to twice as much time as necessary, assuming an equal number of results will be evaluated through each of the resulting iterables.

fix_pr.title: Make pred=None work in partition again
fix_pr.body: Re: https://github.com/erikrose/more-itertools/issues/366, this PR restores the previous `pred=None` behavior for `partition`.
